wrapped:

  gap: 1ex

The reference doc sets a Letter page with 1 in margins and a 0.5 in
gutter, so a percent width is a share of 8640 twips of text. Run
`python3 tests/reference_narrow.py` first, or `python3 tests/verify.py`,
which writes the reference docs. In Word the metadata width and gap take
the built-in defaults with a warning each.
